# SpikeEncoding

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The process of converting continuous fMRI signals into discrete spike trains suitable for spiking neural network processing. Critical for bridging biological neural data with neuromorphic hardware, preserving temporal dynamics and energy efficiency.
